promotionalText: New desktop widget, easier tips, better onboarding, and broader localization for CaffeinateBar.
whatsNew:
New desktop widget: check whether CaffeinateBar is keeping your computer awake right from the desktop, with quick controls when there is room.

Improved support: App Store builds now include tip options, while direct-download builds keep the PayPal support link.

Smoother first run: the tutorial can be opened again any time, and the rating prompt now waits until you have completed a real session.

Also improved localization coverage across the app.
